top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a defined virological advance whose mature clinical and population-level evidence establishes durable prevention of HPV infection and HPV-associated cancers. The Lowy-Frazer-Schiller allocation is defensible for the narrowly bounded VLP-vaccine achievement, while not purporting to assign all credit for the broader development and implementation history.
recusal_note: I co-authored a 2009 paper with committee colleague Thomas Perlmann; no candidate-specific connection requiring recusal is apparent from the supplied profile.
